Title: Generally available: Azure Private Link for Azure SignalR Service

Body.Content:
Azure Private Link support for Azure SignalR Service is now generally available in all Azure SignalR Service available regions. This capability allows your virtual network resources to communicate privately with Azure SignalR Service.

Use Private Link to connect to Azure SignalR Service instance from virtual network via private endpoint, and configure the network access control to secure your cloud end communications with Azure SignalR Service.

Learn more.
